reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for discovering, enabling, and summoning specialist subagents, with configurable expert catalogs and a settings interface.

summaries.zh: 用于在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理并调用专业智能体的插件，支持专家目录搜索、启用配置和一次性子智能体委派。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin for managing and invoking specialist agents through searchable expert catalogs, settings, and one-shot subagent delegation.

capabilities: Provides a catalog of 271 specialist agent personas
Lets users search, enable, and select experts through settings and composer UI
Lists experts and summons one-shot specialist subagents
Supports configurable external expert directories and persona/tool filtering
